text: The service was random. I went with 4 friends and booked a package including Vietnamese hair spa and ear spa (1400 THB per person, 10% discount). The staff didn't treat us equally. My friend and I got someone who seemed unwilling to help, compared to the service my two friends received – it was a completely different story. There were many steps involved, and they missed some parts where we were just chatting. My friend got a full arm massage, including finger massage and stroking each knuckle, while I only got a perfunctory press. The hair wash got water in my ears very often. I felt sorry for the staff; their hands must have been raw from washing. Honestly, if the wash had been quicker and focused on massage, it would have been better. After the hair blow-drying, my male friends got their hair blow-dried first, even though they arrived later (I was the first to sit down, and the previous wash/massage was done very quickly). I told them my hair is long and it should take longer, and asked why they didn't blow-dry it first. The way they combed my hair was so painful I had to tell them to stop. It was incredibly half-hearted service, like they were about to quit and had lost all interest in providing good service.😅 Don't even think about doing the ear spa; it was nothing special, just candles in the ears. I definitely won't be coming back. I was so angry and wanted to talk to the owner, but the other staff members that my friends said were good were just sitting there smiling at us, so I ended up complaining outside the shop. I'm leaving this feedback with the owner. Train all employees equally, or secretly film them during service.
